limits: Private deterministic V2 integration only. No model calls or source acceptance/model-parity claim.
V1 lint failure remains unchanged and hash-bound. V2 passes new lint/inventory and existing enum-restatement source-text tests; V1 real-command test reuse is explicit and separately counted.
No installation/cherry-pick into the working branch, no candidate rewrite and no accepted savings accounting.
